<summary>
Turns 31–33: Continued inspecting the saved PWT webpage HTML (/root/pwt.html). Found the “Access to the data is provided below” section, which contains direct Dataverse API links for PWT 11.0 downloads: “Excel” at https://dataverse.nl/api/access/datafile/554105 and “Stata” at https://dataverse.nl/api/access/datafile/554030 (plus a Streamlit “Online data access tool” link). This resolves the earlier issue of not finding a PWT download URL pattern.

Turns 34–35: Tried to pull IMF WEO data via the legacy weorept.aspx URL for Georgia (country code c=915; series NGDP_R and NGDP_RPCH). The request 302-redirected to /redirect/default.aspx and ultimately landed on an IMF 404 page (no table/data returned).

Turn 36: Queried IMF DataMapper API indicators list. Indicators containing “NGDP” found include NGDPD (nominal GDP current prices) and NGDP_RPCH (Real GDP growth), but no obvious “real GDP level” indicator was identified from this list.

Turn 37: Verified the provided workbook still has no numeric entries in sheet “WEO_Data” for the 2000–2027 rows/columns checked (numeric rows count = 0).

Turns 38–42: Attempted to access the IMF WEO database landing page (e.g., /en/publications/weo/weo-database/2026/april). Requests returned “Access Denied” (Akamai/edgesuite), even when using a browser-like User-Agent. No download links could be scraped due to the access denial.

Turns 43–45: Probed common IMF WEO database file patterns under /-/media/Files/Publications/WEO/WEO-Database/{year}/{month}/WEO{Mon}{Year}all.ashx. The .ashx endpoints returned 302 redirects to a PDF (e.g., weoapr2026all.pdf / weoapr2024all.pdf), but the follow-up response returned application/xml with x-ms-error-code: BlobNotFound (indicating the redirected object was not found/served). WEO bulk download still not obtained.

No Excel edits/saves occurred in this window; progress was mainly locating the correct PWT download link (successful) while IMF WEO data retrieval remains blocked/unresolved in this environment.</summary>
